question: Can Needle represent a private actor's legally recognized categorical determination as a public-law regulatory input without pretending the private source is an official authority?

private_determination.source_identifier: S&P Global Ratings Research Update: Capri Holdings Ltd. Rating Lowered To 'BB' From 'BBB-'

public_law_recognition_chain.statement: An external credit assessment may be used to determine the risk weight under the standardized approach only if issued or endorsed by an ECAI in accordance with Regulation (EC) No 1060/2009.

public_law_recognition_chain.provision: Annex III, S&P Global Ratings Europe Limited long-term issuer credit rating scale

conditional_evaluation.condition: Only where an institution has nominated the relevant ECAI and the assessment is directly applicable to the exposure under CRR rules.

source_observation_v0_1.reason: Source Observation permits only official/public source systems; the direct S&P rating action is a private primary source whose legal relevance comes from EU recognition rather than official authorship.

authoritative_finding_v0_1.reason: An ordinal rating is a categorical determination, but Authoritative Finding restricts authority types and finding-source vocabulary to public/official authorities and systems.

authoritative_metric_observation_v0_1.reason: BBB-/BB are ordinal private classifications, not authoritative numeric measurements.

authoritative_dynamic_set_v0_1.reason: The rating is not membership/status in a public authoritative set.

forbidden_inferences: S&P Global Ratings is an EU institution, agency or other official authority.
The S&P rating action textually amends the CRR or Implementing Regulation 2016/1799.
Every EU bank uses S&P for Capri Holdings exposures.
Every Capri exposure in the EU changed from 75% to 100% risk weight on 20 February 2025.
The ordinal rating should be coerced into a numeric metric merely to reuse Authoritative Metric Observation.
EU recognition of a private determination converts the private source itself into an official EU source.

official_and_primary_sources.identifier: S&P Global Ratings, 20 February 2025 Capri Holdings rating action

official_and_primary_sources.locator: Annex III, S&P Global Ratings Europe Limited
